fusions.name: Cliffside Stamp
fusions.desc: Plants your hooves and stamps, dealing 11 rock damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning them for 0.8 seconds.

fusions.name: Horn Lock
fusions.desc: A head-down blow that deals 9 rock damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Also costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Firm Footing
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 20% and your dodge chance by 8% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Off the Ledge
fusions.desc: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.
